project_info.color_palette: Hot red, golden yellow, electric blue, orange

main_subject.detail: A vivid ShopeeVIP summer voucher poster with a crowned Shopee box mascot wearing sunglasses and a tropical shirt. Top banner reads 'ShopeeVIP TUNG VOUCHER' and giant text says 'DON HE RUC RO'. The mascot holds a phone showing sunscreen and sunglasses. Three large blue voucher tickets dominate the lower half with exact text: 'VOUCHER GIAM 30% DEN 100.000D Tu 15.7 toi 20.7', 'VOUCHER GIAM 25% DEN 200.000D Tu 15.7 toi 20.7', and 'VOUCHER GIAM 25% DEN 200.000D Tu 25.7 toi 31.7'. Bottom orange bar says 'Luu va su dung ma trong cac khung gio 0H - 9H - 12H - 15H - 18H - 21H'.
main_subject.style: High-energy summer membership promo with 3D mascot, tropical props, and oversized voucher-ticket composition

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a ShopeeVIP summer voucher campaign. Centerpiece is a crowned Shopee box mascot in sunglasses and a tropical shirt holding a phone with summer items on screen. Background is a hot red-orange summer glow with palm ornaments, confetti, and gift boxes. Surrounding elements: Shopee and ShopeeVIP logos, top text 'ShopeeVIP TUNG VOUCHER', giant title 'DON HE RUC RO', three oversized blue voucher tickets with the exact visible percentages, discount caps, and date ranges, plus the bottom orange bar 'Luu va su dung ma trong cac khung gio 0H - 9H - 12H - 15H - 18H - 21H'. Technical style: 3D mascot voucher poster with bright promotional compositing, tropical promo lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
